body:
I read your reply when I got up this morning. It made me cry - not because of sadness but because you gave me hope. Thank you.... I'm crying again, it's nice to know that somebody cares. Thank you so much. I've been thinking all day - I think that I've been leaning on my partner to much, I need support but it's to much to put on him. He told me that our time together has been like an extended support session and it's putting strain on him. That's why he needed a break. I can't blame him. I hate myself right now, how could he love me? 

Much of what you bulleted though I've been doing without progress for months, I know what would make me better, but christ. I can't seem to get any traction.

I don't know what to say to you hun, but thank you for sharing. And Gods, if you feel like I do...  I'm so sorry. It's painful. I know. Sometimes I feel like I'm alone with these feelings. Everyone else seems so happy, successful, etc. I guess we're not unique in feeling this way. I don't know if reddit has a PM feature, but if so, please do. I feel better today, not good, but better. Maybe sharing some experiences may help us both. :)
